t_advice_summary_textbox.text: They told me to keep an eye on which colour gnomes will bring me to which forest (bright or dark). Gnomes always appear in pairs, the pairs are always the same. I need to find which one of the forest bring more mushrooms and try to pick the gnome that will take me there

vb_textbox.text: I found the the gnomes thatfound the most mushrooms were always the same.Normally you will have to choose between 2 gnomes, they always come in a pair and they never change. (pink and green, brown and orange, yellow and red, blue and purple)There are 2 type of forests, but I realised that doesn't matter.For me personally it was always the gnomes with the darker hat that found the most mushrooms.
